trials.title: An LRU cache with TTL (openrouter)
trials.reason: left open: the warden: The test setting is fine in itself (it adds a gate rather than loosening one), but it shouldn't come in through this PR. 'trials' runs several models side by side on the same tasks: at least five other open checkouts also write lru/ and go.mod. One trial's PR shouldn't quietly set the project-wide test gate that every other trial's work is then judged by. The goals also mention trying other harnesses and tasks, which may not all be Go. And -race needs cgo/gcc in the check environment, which this change doesn't show is there. Route: drop the .hive/project.json change from PR #11 so the trial code can merge on its own merits, and have the project lead propose the test command as a separate change after confirming 'go test -race ./...' runs in the Hive's checks (or use 'go test ./...').
